```{r}
# Standardize County column: lowercase + no spaces
fix_county <- function(df, col = "County") {
  df %>% rename(County = all_of(col)) %>%
    mutate(County = County |> str_to_lower() |> str_replace_all(" ", ""))
}

pred_tick <- fix_county(pred_tick)           # already named "County"
tbd_inc   <- fix_county(tbd_inc)             # already named "County"
tick_exp  <- fix_county(tick_exp)            # already named "County"
tbp_prev  <- fix_county(tbp_prev, "COUNTY") # uppercase → rename first

# Full join all four
tbd_all <- pred_tick %>%

  full_join(tick_exp, by = "County") %>%
  full_join(tbp_prev, by = "County")
```

## Smoothing of TBP prevlence
```{r}
library(sf)
library(spdep)
library(dplyr)

# Build first order neighbor list
nb <- poly2nb(tbd_all)
lw <- nb2listw(nb, style = "W", zero.policy = TRUE)

# Global mean prevalence (ignoring NA), this never fails
global_mean_aa <- mean(tbd_all$Prev_aa, na.rm = TRUE)
global_mean_dv <- mean(tbd_all$Prev_dv, na.rm = TRUE)
global_mean_is <- mean(tbd_all$Prev_is, na.rm = TRUE)

# Local neighbor mean (can be NA if neighbors are also NA)
tbd_all <- tbd_all %>%
  mutate(
    local_aa = lag.listw(lw, Prev_aa, zero.policy = TRUE, NAOK = TRUE),
    local_dv = lag.listw(lw, Prev_dv, zero.policy = TRUE, NAOK = TRUE),
    local_is = lag.listw(lw, Prev_is, zero.policy = TRUE, NAOK = TRUE)
  )

# Empirical Bayes shrinkage function
# weight = how much to trust local/own data vs global mean
# Total_tested determines confidence: more ticks tested = trust local data more
eb_smooth <- function(own_val, local_val, global_val, n_tested, k = 10) {
  n_tested <- ifelse(is.na(n_tested), 0, n_tested)
  w <- n_tested / (n_tested + k)   # shrinkage weight, grows toward 1 with more samples

  # Fallback hierarchy: own value -> local neighbor mean -> global mean
  base_val <- ifelse(!is.na(own_val), own_val,
                     ifelse(!is.na(local_val), local_val, global_val))

  # Blend base value with global mean based on confidence weight
  smoothed <- w * base_val + (1 - w) * global_val
  return(smoothed)
}

# Apply to each species using their respective total tested counts
tbd_all <- tbd_all %>%
  mutate(
    Prev_aa_smooth = eb_smooth(Prev_aa, local_aa, global_mean_aa, Num_Tested_aa, k = 10),
    Prev_dv_smooth = eb_smooth(Prev_dv, local_dv, global_mean_dv, Num_Tested_dv, k = 10),
    Prev_is_smooth = eb_smooth(Prev_is, local_is, global_mean_is, Num_Tested_is, k = 10)
  )

cat("AA remaining NA:", sum(is.na(tbd_all$Prev_aa_smooth)), "\n")
cat("DV remaining NA:", sum(is.na(tbd_all$Prev_dv_smooth)), "\n")
cat("IS remaining NA:", sum(is.na(tbd_all$Prev_is_smooth)), "\n")

tbd_all %>%
  st_drop_geometry() %>%
  select(County, Prev_aa, Num_Tested_aa, Prev_aa_smooth,
         Prev_dv, Num_Tested_dv, Prev_dv_smooth,
         Prev_is, Num_Tested_is, Prev_is_smooth) %>%
  head(15)

#View(tbd_all)
```


## Scaling IDPH TBP prevalence smoothed data
```{r}
# Scale function — zeros stay zero, NAs stay NA
scale_01 <- function(x) {
  zero_mask <- !is.na(x) & x == 0
  na_mask   <- is.na(x)
  
  q_low  <- quantile(x, 0.01, na.rm = TRUE)
  q_high <- quantile(x, 0.99, na.rm = TRUE)
  
  x_clipped <- pmin(pmax(x, q_low), q_high)
  scaled <- (x_clipped - q_low) / (q_high - q_low)
  scaled <- scaled * 0.98 + 0.01
  
  scaled[zero_mask] <- 0
  scaled[na_mask]   <- NA
  
  return(scaled)
}

# Add scaled columns directly onto tbd_all, keeping all original columns + geometry
tbd_all <- tbd_all %>%
  mutate(
    Prev_aa_scaled = scale_01(Prev_aa_smooth),
    Prev_dv_scaled = scale_01(Prev_dv_smooth),
    Prev_is_scaled = scale_01(Prev_is_smooth)
  ) %>%
  mutate(across(c(Prev_aa_smooth, Prev_dv_smooth, Prev_is_smooth,
                  Prev_aa_scaled, Prev_dv_scaled, Prev_is_scaled),
                ~ round(.x, 5)))

# Confirm tbd_all still has all original columns plus the new ones
names(tbd_all)

# Build a trimmed export-only dataframe with just the selected columns
val_scaled <- tbd_all %>%
  st_drop_geometry() %>%
  select(County, Status_aa, Num_Tested_aa, Num_Positive_aa, Prev_aa, Prev_aa_smooth,
         Status_is, Num_Tested_is, Num_Positive_is, Prev_is, Prev_is_smooth,
         Status_dv, Num_Tested_dv, Num_Positive_dv, Prev_dv, Prev_dv_smooth,
         Prev_aa_scaled, Prev_dv_scaled, Prev_is_scaled)

print(val_scaled)

# Export only the trimmed version to CSV
out_path <- "C:/Users/abrar/OneDrive - University of Illinois - Urbana/Documents/Abrar Hussain/Ph.D/Ph.D. Papers/As Authors/TBD Risk Score Illinois/Data/IDPH/idph_combined_data_smoothed_scaled.csv"
write_csv(val_scaled, out_path)
cat("Saved to:", out_path, "\n")

# Update the complete combined dataset after prevalence smoothing and scaling
tbd_all %>%
  st_drop_geometry() %>%
  write_csv(
    "C:/Users/abrar/OneDrive - University of Illinois - Urbana/Documents/Abrar Hussain/Ph.D/Ph.D. Papers/As Authors/TBD Risk Score Illinois/Data/Combine spatial dataset/tbd_all.csv"
```

## Maping
```{r}
library(ggplot2)
library(scales)
library(viridis)
library(sf)
library(grid)
library(patchwork)

## THEME
my_theme <- theme_minimal(base_family = "sans") +
  ggplot2::theme(
    panel.background = element_rect(fill = "white", color = NA),
    plot.background  = element_rect(fill = "white", color = NA),
    panel.grid       = element_blank(),
    plot.title       = element_text(hjust = 0.5, size = 12, face = "italic"),
    legend.title     = element_blank(),
    legend.text      = element_text(size = 12),
    axis.text.x      = element_blank(),
    axis.text.y      = element_blank(),
    axis.ticks.x     = element_blank(),
    axis.ticks.y     = element_blank(),
    axis.title.x     = element_blank(),
    axis.title.y     = element_blank()
  )

## SINGLE SCALE FOR ALL MAPS
my_scale <- scale_fill_gradientn(
  colors = c(
    "white",
    viridis::plasma(100, direction = 1)
  ),
  values = scales::rescale(c(
    0,
    seq(0.0001, 1, length.out = 100)
  )),
  na.value = "grey70",
  limits = c(0, 1),
  breaks = c(0.25, 0.50, 0.75, 1.00),
  labels = c("0.25", "0.50", "0.75", "1.00"),
  guide = guide_colorbar(
    direction = "vertical",
    barwidth = unit(0.5, "cm"),
    barheight = unit(4, "cm"),
    title = NULL
  )
)

## SWATCH GROB — square boxes, black text
swatch_grob <- function() {
  grobTree(
    rectGrob(
      x = 0.22, y = 0.70,
      width = 0.25, height = 0.25,
      gp = gpar(fill = "white", col = "grey60", lwd = 0.8)
    ),
    textGrob("0",  x = 0.75, y = 0.70,    # matches white box
             gp = gpar(fontsize = 12, col = "black")),
    rectGrob(
      x = 0.22, y = 0.25,
      width = 0.25, height = 0.25,
      gp = gpar(fill = "grey70", col = "grey60", lwd = 0.8)
    ),
    textGrob("NA", x = 0.75, y = 0.25,    # matches grey box
             gp = gpar(fontsize = 12, col = "black"))
  )
}

out_dir <- "C:/Users/abrar/OneDrive - University of Illinois - Urbana/Documents/Abrar Hussain/Ph.D/Ph.D. Papers/As Authors/TBD Risk Score Illinois/Output"

add_leg <- function(p) p + ggplot2::theme(legend.position = "right")

save_panel <- function(plots, filename, w = 10, h = 4.5) {
  panel <- wrap_plots(lapply(plots, add_leg),
                      ncol   = 3,
                      guides = "collect")
  png(file.path(out_dir, filename), width = w, height = h,
      units = "in", res = 300)
  grid.newpage()
  print(panel, newpage = FALSE)

  if (!filename %in% c("panel_predicted_ticks.png",
                     "panel_pathogen_prevalence_Smoothed.png")) {
    vp <- viewport(x = 0.85, y = 0.20, width = 0.055, height = 0.18)
    pushViewport(vp)
    grid.draw(swatch_grob())
    popViewport()
  }

  dev.off()
  message("Saved: ", filename)
}

save_panel(list(p_PM_aa_scaled,       p_PM_dv_scaled,       p_PM_is_scaled),
           "panel_predicted_ticks.png")
```
